I love these! They are super easy to use! They are so much easier than glue on falsies. I would definitely recommend.

The best way to apply is to apply 2-3 coats as close to the lash line as possible and let it dry completely before adding the lashes! (I do the rest of my makeup while I wait) I wore the lashes yesterday for almost 12 hours and not a single mishap! would definitely recommend trying these lashes!

You do have to let the liner dry and once you put them on, they're amazing. The lashes themselves are also pretty and long but not extreme and fake looking. I'm in love

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to apply, especially compared to glue-on lashes.
Many reviewers say the magnetic liner takes a little longer to dry but is worth the wait.
Several reviewers mention the lashes stay on securely and work well.
A few reviewers note the lashes are too dramatic or thick and wish for more natural size options.
Some reviewers mention removal can be a struggle, with eyeliner residue or chunks coming off.
